chapterInfo.content:
1
Nyansa frɛ
1 # 1 Ah 4.29-32 Israelhene Salomo, Dawid ba no mmebusɛm nie:
2Sɛ nnipa mfa nhunu nyansa ne nkyerɛkyerɛ,
sɛ wɔmfa nhunu nhunumu nsɛm mu;
3sɛ wɔmfa nnye nimdeɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ,
tenenee, atemmuo ne adeɛ a ɛtene;
4sɛ wɔmfa nkyerɛ ntetekwaa aniteɛ,
aberanteɛ nso nimdeɛ ne adwempa:
5Na onyansafoɔ ntie, na ne nimdeɛ nnɔɔso,
na onimdefoɔ mfa nnya atɛmpa:
6Sɛ wɔmfa nhunu abebusɛm ne akasabebuo,
anyansafoɔ nsɛm ne wɔn mmɛ mu.
7 # Mmb 9.10; Dwom 111.10; Hiob 28.28 AWURADE suro ne nimdeɛ mfitiaseɛ;
agyimifoɔ bu nyansa ne nkyerɛkyerɛ animtia.
8 # Mmb 6.20 Me ba, tie w’agya akwankyerɛ,
na mpo wo na nkyerɛkyerɛ,
9 # Mmb 4.9 na ɛyɛ wo tiri animuonyam abotire
ne wo kɔn mu ntweaban.
Nnyegyeɛ ho kɔkɔbɔ
10Me ba, sɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ gyegye wo a,
mpene!
11Sɛ wɔse: Bra ma yɛnkɔ mogya ho adɛm,
ma yɛnkɔtɛ deɛ ɔdi bem kwa;
12ma yɛmmemene wɔn anikan sɛ Asamando,
ne amudifoɔ sɛ wɔn a wɔsiane kɔ Amena mu;
13yɛbɛnya adeɛ a ne boɔ yɛ den nyinaa,
yɛde asadeɛ bɛhyɛ yɛn afie ma.
14Fa wo kyɛfa bɛbɔ yɛn deɛ mu,
yɛn nyinaa bɛnya kotokuo baako.
15Me ba, wo ne wɔn nnnante ɔkwan so.
Twe wo nan firi wɔn sa so.
16Na wɔn nan tu mmirika kɔ bɔne mu,
na wɔyɛ ntɛm hwie mogya gu.
17Na kwa ara na wɔasum fidie
ntakraboa nyinaa anim.
18Nanso wɔn ara wɔn mogya ho na wɔkɔ adɛm,
wɔtɛ wɔn ara wɔn kra.
19Saa na amim mu mfasopɛfoɔ nyinaa akwan teɛ,
ɛfa ne wuranom kra kɔ.
Asoɔden ho asotwe
20Nyansa team mmorɔno so,
ɔma wɔte ne nne mmɔntene so;
21 # Mmb 8.1 ɔteam adwabirem tire,
kuro mu, kuro apono ano, ɔka ne nsɛm sɛ:
22Da bɛn ara na mo ntetekwaa mobɛpɛ ntetekwaasɛm akɔsie?
Na afɛdifoɔ bɛpɛ wɔn afɛdie,
na nkwaseafoɔ akyiri nimdeɛ?
23Monnane mo ho mma me kasakyerɛ.
Hwɛ, mɛworo me honhom ama mo,
mɛma moahunu me nsɛm.
24 # Yes 65.2, 12 Sɛ mafrɛ, na mokame,
matene me nsam, na obi mfa nyɛ hwee,
25na moto m’afotuo nyinaa twene,
na me kasakyerɛ no, mompɛ nti,
26 # Mmb 3.34 me nso mɛsere mo mo amaneɛ mu,
mo ahopopoɔ bɛba no, mɛyi mo ahi.
27Mo ahopopoɔ ba sɛ aprannaa,
na mo amaneɛ ba sɛ ahum,
ahohiahia ne ahokyere ba mo so a,
28 # Yes 59.2; Mika 3.4 ɛno na wɔbɛfrɛ me, na merennye so,
wɔbɛhwehwɛ me nhema, na wɔrenhu me.
29Ɛsiane sɛ wɔkyiri nimdeɛ,
na wɔampɛ AWURADE suro,
30wɔampɛ m’afotuo,
na wɔpoo me kasakyerɛ nyinaa,
31 # Yes 3.10-11 enti wɔbɛdi wɔn kwan so aba,
na wɔn agyina a wɔtutuiɛ amee wɔn.
32 # Mmb 8.36 Na ntetekwaa akyirisan bɛku wɔn,
na nkwasea yiedie bɛsɛe wɔn.
33 # Mmb 8.34 Na deɛ ɔtie me no deɛ ɔbɛtena hɔ komm,
na ne ho adwo no a ɔnsuro mmusuo.

pageProps.chapterText:
Israelhene Salomo, Dawid ba no mmebusɛm nie:
Sɛ nnipa mfa nhunu nyansa ne nkyerɛkyerɛ,
sɛ wɔmfa nhunu nhunumu nsɛm mu;
sɛ wɔmfa nnye nimdeɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ,
tenenee, atemmuo ne adeɛ a ɛtene;
sɛ wɔmfa nkyerɛ ntetekwaa aniteɛ,
aberanteɛ nso nimdeɛ ne adwempa:
Na onyansafoɔ ntie, na ne nimdeɛ nnɔɔso,
na onimdefoɔ mfa nnya atɛmpa:
Sɛ wɔmfa nhunu abebusɛm ne akasabebuo,
anyansafoɔ nsɛm ne wɔn mmɛ mu.
AWURADE suro ne nimdeɛ mfitiaseɛ;
agyimifoɔ bu nyansa ne nkyerɛkyerɛ animtia.
Me ba, tie w’agya akwankyerɛ,
na mpo wo na nkyerɛkyerɛ,
na ɛyɛ wo tiri animuonyam abotire
ne wo kɔn mu ntweaban.

Me ba, sɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ gyegye wo a,
mpene!
Sɛ wɔse: Bra ma yɛnkɔ mogya ho adɛm,
ma yɛnkɔtɛ deɛ ɔdi bem kwa;
ma yɛmmemene wɔn anikan sɛ Asamando,
ne amudifoɔ sɛ wɔn a wɔsiane kɔ Amena mu;
yɛbɛnya adeɛ a ne boɔ yɛ den nyinaa,
yɛde asadeɛ bɛhyɛ yɛn afie ma.
Fa wo kyɛfa bɛbɔ yɛn deɛ mu,
yɛn nyinaa bɛnya kotokuo baako.
Me ba, wo ne wɔn nnnante ɔkwan so.
Twe wo nan firi wɔn sa so.
Na wɔn nan tu mmirika kɔ bɔne mu,
na wɔyɛ ntɛm hwie mogya gu.
Na kwa ara na wɔasum fidie
ntakraboa nyinaa anim.
Nanso wɔn ara wɔn mogya ho na wɔkɔ adɛm,
wɔtɛ wɔn ara wɔn kra.
Saa na amim mu mfasopɛfoɔ nyinaa akwan teɛ,
ɛfa ne wuranom kra kɔ.

Nyansa team mmorɔno so,
ɔma wɔte ne nne mmɔntene so;
ɔteam adwabirem tire,
kuro mu, kuro apono ano, ɔka ne nsɛm sɛ:
Da bɛn ara na mo ntetekwaa mobɛpɛ ntetekwaasɛm akɔsie?
Na afɛdifoɔ bɛpɛ wɔn afɛdie,
na nkwaseafoɔ akyiri nimdeɛ?
Monnane mo ho mma me kasakyerɛ.
Hwɛ, mɛworo me honhom ama mo,
mɛma moahunu me nsɛm.
Sɛ mafrɛ, na mokame,
matene me nsam, na obi mfa nyɛ hwee,
na moto m’afotuo nyinaa twene,
na me kasakyerɛ no, mompɛ nti,
me nso mɛsere mo mo amaneɛ mu,
mo ahopopoɔ bɛba no, mɛyi mo ahi.
Mo ahopopoɔ ba sɛ aprannaa,
na mo amaneɛ ba sɛ ahum,
ahohiahia ne ahokyere ba mo so a,
ɛno na wɔbɛfrɛ me, na merennye so,
wɔbɛhwehwɛ me nhema, na wɔrenhu me.
Ɛsiane sɛ wɔkyiri nimdeɛ,
na wɔampɛ AWURADE suro,
wɔampɛ m’afotuo,
na wɔpoo me kasakyerɛ nyinaa,
enti wɔbɛdi wɔn kwan so aba,
na wɔn agyina a wɔtutuiɛ amee wɔn.
Na ntetekwaa akyirisan bɛku wɔn,
na nkwasea yiedie bɛsɛe wɔn.
Na deɛ ɔtie me no deɛ ɔbɛtena hɔ komm,
na ne ho adwo no a ɔnsuro mmusuo.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
